about: Hand-written EXPLAIN outputs against one payload, each with the numerals the deterministic check must reject (section 40 [C17]).

cases.name: grounded: times, waits, labelled preferences and the unmet must-do
cases.output: Space Mountain comes first at 09:05, your must-do, with a 27 minute wait; Guest 2 sits it out (minimum 112 cm). Your thrill preference of 0.8 (stated) and a learned 0.33 queue weight (learned) put Big Thunder Mountain next at 9:57 with a 13 minute wait. In all: 2 stops, 40 minutes of waiting, 8 of walking. TRON could not fit today.

cases.name: an invented wait
cases.output: Space Mountain at 09:05 has a 35 minute wait.

cases.name: a computed sum (27 + 13)
cases.output: Expect 40 minutes of waiting: 27 plus 13, so about 41 with the walk.

cases.name: a converted figure (0.8 as a percentage)
cases.output: You told us you love thrills (80% match).

cases.name: a bare hour and an invented time
cases.output: Head over around 9 and be done by 11:00.

cases.name: a precise figure rounded
cases.output: Space Mountain scores about 0.8 for you; it ranks 1st.

cases.name: a guest's height (never in the payload)
cases.output: Guest 2 (90 cm) is too short for Space Mountain (minimum 112 cm).

label_cases.name: labels right, including two weights in one sentence
label_cases.output: Your thrill preference of 0.8 (stated) and a learned 0.33 queue weight (learned) shaped the order.

label_cases.output: Thrill counts a lot for you (0.8).
